title: A9 motorway: car strikes stopped van
location_guess: A9 motorway near Munich, Germany (TUM Traffic gantry cameras)
summary: A white panel van stands stopped in lane 1 (next to the median) of a busy three-lane carriageway. Traffic steers around it. At about 22.3 s a yellow car leaves lane 2 with an unsteady swerve, clips the van's rear median-side corner with its front, spins clockwise and stops pressed against the median barrier behind the van, which is shoved about 4 m forward. Lane-2 traffic behind the crash brakes hard and queues; lane 3 slows.

crash.description: Yellow car swerves from lane 2 toward the gap between the stopped white van and the median, its front-right corner strikes the van's rear median-side corner, it spins clockwise against the barrier and stops behind the van; the van is pushed ~4 m forward and yaws ~8 deg. Debris across lane 1.

caveats: Hand-authored from frame-by-frame review of the 12.5 fps mosaic; not measured with a calibrated camera.
Positions and speeds are approximate (perspective estimates, +/- a few metres and ~2 m/s).
Contact at ~22.3 s is partly occluded by the van; the impulse and forces are derived from the reconstructed motion, not measured.
The yellow car's spin is limited to ~30 deg here so it fits between the van and the median barrier.
Background traffic is a plausible simulation matching the observed density, lanes and behaviour, not a vehicle-by-vehicle track; trucks are shortened to the viewer's maximum.
The van's driver appears on foot near the van late in the clip; pedestrians are not reconstructed.
